name: Los Angeles
summary: The sprawling capital of entertainment — Hollywood and the studios, the Getty and the Broad, the beaches at Santa Monica and Venice, and the theme parks. A big, sun-soaked stay.

lodging.name: A Santa Monica or Hollywood hotel
lodging.blurb: Beach-side or in the middle of the action.

foodMustTry.name: Tacos & a French dip
foodMustTry.blurb: World-class taco trucks — and the LA-invented French dip.

days.label: Day 427 — Hollywood
days.summary: Stars, the sign, and the observatory.

item.title: Hollywood Boulevard & the sign
item.blurb: The Walk of Fame, the Chinese Theatre handprints, and views of the Hollywood Sign.

item.title: Griffith Observatory

location.name: Griffith Observatory
location.address: 2800 E Observatory Rd, Los Angeles, CA

item.blurb: The Art Deco observatory with the definitive city-and-sign view, best at sunset.

item.title: The Getty Center

location.name: The Getty Center
location.address: 1200 Getty Center Dr, Los Angeles, CA

item.blurb: A hilltop museum of European art, gardens, and architecture — free, with a tram up.

item.title: Santa Monica Pier & Venice Beach

location.name: Santa Monica Pier
location.address: 200 Santa Monica Pier, Santa Monica, CA

item.blurb: The pier, the beach, and the boardwalk carnival of Venice.

item.title: The Broad & Downtown

location.name: The Broad
location.address: 221 S Grand Ave, Los Angeles, CA

item.blurb: Contemporary art (free) beside Disney Concert Hall, plus Grand Central Market for lunch.

item.title: Universal Studios Hollywood

location.name: Universal Studios Hollywood
location.address: 100 Universal City Plaza, Universal City, CA

item.blurb: The studio tram tour and the theme-park rides (or save it for the free day).

days.label: Day 430 — Free Day
days.summary: Disneyland, more beach, or a studio tour. Options below.

freeMenu.title: Disneyland (Anaheim)
freeMenu.blurb: The original Magic Kingdom, about an hour southeast.

freeMenu.title: LACMA & the La Brea Tar Pits
freeMenu.blurb: The county art museum's 'Urban Light' and the Ice Age fossils bubbling up next door.

commute.scenicNote: Northwest up the coast to Santa Barbara.
